title: Unexpected awaitable cleanup stops after a throwing cancel hook
description: python/src/lichen/_sync_callbacks.py calls a custom awaitable's cancel() and then close() without guarding cleanup exceptions. If cancel raises, close is skipped and the cleanup exception escapes instead of the documented deterministic TypeError, potentially leaving a rejected callback result live. Make best-effort cancellation/closure exception-safe while preserving the primary rejection, avoid double side effects, and add custom awaitables whose cancel/close individually raise.
